cohort: Five women with Noonan syndrome (10 pregnancies) at Yale-New Haven Hospital from 2012 to 2020
finding: Women with Noonan syndrome and low-risk cardiac lesions can experience pregnancy and deliver infants, but there is a high rate of prematurity, caesarean section, and neonatal intensive care unit admissions.
mod_finding: 80% of deliveries in women with Noonan syndrome were converted to caesarean section after a trial of labor.
